mapper.select: insert into mail_send_attempts (user_id, email, mail_type, send_status, request_id) values (#{userId}, lower(#{email}), #{mailType}, 'REQUESTED', #{requestId}) returning attempt_id
mapper.update: update mail_send_attempts set send_status = 'SENT', sent_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where attempt_id = #{attemptId}
